chapter: 搜决神鬼章第七十四(中)
chapter_en: Chapter 74: Searching out ghosts and spirits (part 2)

units.chapter_en: Chapter 74: Searching out ghosts and spirits
units.title: 看鬼临何卦何爻发动，知犯何神何煞：八宫方位（坎北水口、离南灶前、艮山林东北、坤坟墓西南、乾西北兑西天曹寺观、巽东南、震东伐树起造）；爻位动工（六造墙作墓、五砌路修街、四门栏檐下、三房内桥梁、二修厨作灶、初穿井开沟）；世为本宅兴修、应为对门垦掘

rule.yi: 看鬼落在哪一卦、哪一爻发动，就知道在那里冒犯了什么神、什么煞，因而牵连上身：官鬼在坎位，是北方来侵，或是兴动水口；鬼到离宫，是南向的妨碍，或是在灶前动工；艮主山林，或是遭遇东北；坤成坟墓，或是值西南；乾是西北，兑是西方，或是冒犯天曹、修寺观；巽是东南；震是东方，或是砍伐树林并起造。六爻的鬼，必是造墙作墓；五爻的官，必是砌路修街；四爻，断门栏，或是在檐下动工；三爻，推房内，或是动犯桥梁；二爻，是修厨房、作灶；初爻，是穿井、开沟；鬼在世爻上，是本宅动了工；在应爻上，是对门在挖掘；临门的爻，是开窗不便；变出兄弟，是挖坑、建造不通。注说：以上说的，都是把上面的鬼逐一说明白，不必再注。
rule.en: Look at which trigram and which line the ghost moves in, to know where a god or a killing was offended and thereby brought on the body: the Pressure line in the Kan place means encroachment from the north, or works at a water mouth; a ghost at the Li palace means obstruction facing south, or works in front of the stove; Gen governs mountain and forest, or meets the northeast; Kun makes graves, or falls southwest; Qian is northwest and Dui is west, or an offence against the Heavenly Bureau in repairing a temple or abbey; Xun is southeast; Zhen is east, or felling woods and building. A ghost on the sixth line surely means building a wall or making a grave; the Pressure line on the fifth surely means paving a road or repairing a street; the fourth, judge gates and railings, or works under the eaves; the third, work out the inside of the house, or works offending bridges and beams; the second is repairing the kitchen or making a stove; the first is digging a well or opening a ditch; on the Self line, works on one's own house; on the Other line, digging opposite the door; on the door line, opening a window is inconvenient; changing into Peer, a pit or structure is blocked. The commentary says: all of the above sets the ghosts out one by one, and there is no need for further notes.

zh: 看鬼临何卦何爻而发动，知那处犯神犯煞以干连。
官居坎位北方侵，或兴水口。
鬼到离宫南向碍，或动灶前。
艮主山林或遭东北。
坤成坟墓或值西南。
乾为西北，兑为西、或犯天曹修寺观。
巽作东南。
震作东，或伐树林并起造。
六鬼必造墙作墓。
五官必砌路修街。
四象断门栏、或兴工于檐下，三爻推房内、或动犯于桥梁。
二乃修厨作灶。
初为穿井开沟。
在世则本宅兴修，在应则对门垦掘。
临门爻，窗开不便。
化兄弟，坑造不通。
yi: 看鬼落在哪一卦、哪一爻发动，就知道在那里冒犯了什么神、什么煞，因而牵连上身。
官鬼在坎位，是北方来侵，或是兴动水口。
鬼到离宫，是南向的妨碍，或是在灶前动工。
艮主山林，或是遭遇东北。
坤成坟墓，或是值西南。
乾是西北，兑是西方，或是冒犯天曹、修寺观。
巽是东南。
震是东方，或是砍伐树林并起造。
六爻的鬼，必是造墙作墓。
五爻的官，必是砌路修街。
四爻，断门栏，或是在檐下动工；三爻，推房内，或是动犯桥梁。
二爻，是修厨房、作灶。
初爻，是穿井、开沟。
鬼在世爻上，是本宅动了工；在应爻上，是对门在挖掘。
临门的爻，是开窗不便。
变出兄弟，是挖坑、建造不通。
en: Look at which trigram and which line the ghost moves in, to know where a god or a killing was offended and thereby brought on the body.
The Pressure line in the Kan place means encroachment from the north, or works at a water mouth.
A ghost at the Li palace means obstruction facing south, or works in front of the stove.
Gen governs mountain and forest, or meets the northeast.
Kun makes graves, or falls southwest.
Qian is northwest and Dui is west, or an offence against the Heavenly Bureau in repairing a temple or abbey.
Xun is southeast.
Zhen is east, or felling woods and building.
A ghost on the sixth line surely means building a wall or making a grave.
The Pressure line on the fifth surely means paving a road or repairing a street.
The fourth, judge gates and railings, or works under the eaves; the third, work out the inside of the house, or works offending bridges and beams.
The second is repairing the kitchen or making a stove.
The first is digging a well or opening a ditch.
On the Self line, works on one's own house; on the Other line, digging opposite the door.
On the door line, opening a window is inconvenient.
Changing into Peer, a pit or structure is blocked.

zh: 以上所言，皆论上鬼逐一开明，不必再注。
yi: 以上说的，都是把上面的鬼逐一说明白，不必再注。
en: All of the above sets the ghosts out one by one, and there is no need for further notes.

note.yi: 这一节和黄金策「修造动土必是煞遇勾陈」（LY.ILL.HJC.100）是同一件事：病由动土修造、犯了土神引起，用鬼所在的卦位定方向，用鬼所在的爻位定动的是什么工（初爻穿井开沟、二爻修厨作灶、三爻房内桥梁、四爻门栏檐下、五爻砌路修街、六爻造墙作墓）。「官」在这里是官鬼的省写。「在世则本宅兴修，在应则对门垦掘」是说鬼落在世爻是自己家动工，落在应爻是对门人家动工。「临门爻」的「门」原文没有说是哪一爻，这里照字面译。「化兄弟，坑造不通」的「不通」读法没有把握。这一段里神、鬼、星煞的名字，是吴地的民间神祇和星煞，书里没有解释，这里按字面译或音译，不作认定。
note.en: This section is the same matter as the Huangjin Ce's 'works and breaking ground surely mean a killing meeting Hook Earth' (LY.ILL.HJC.100): the illness comes from breaking ground or building and offending an earth spirit, the direction is fixed by the palace the ghost is in, and what work was done is fixed by the line the ghost is on (the first line digging a well or ditch, the second repairing the kitchen or making a stove, the third the inside of the house or bridges, the fourth gates and eaves, the fifth paving a road or repairing a street, the sixth building a wall or making a grave). 'Guan' (official) is here short for the Pressure line. 'On the Self, works on one's own house; on the Other, digging opposite the door' means that with the ghost on the Self line the works are in one's own house, and on the Other line in the house across the door. The 'door' of 'the door line' is not said in the original to be any particular line, and is translated literally. The reading of 'is blocked' in 'changing into Peer, a pit or structure is blocked' is uncertain. Names of gods, spirits and stars in this passage are given by transliteration or plain rendering; they are cults and stars of the Wu region that the book does not explain, and none is identified here beyond what the book says.

units.chapter_en: Chapter 74: Searching out ghosts and spirits
units.title: 按十二支断神鬼：亥天门张壬（祠山大帝）、子北斗河伯、丑牛触之魂土神、寅东岳虎伤鬼、卯东岳、辰土神龙王、巳火德星君蚕室蛇伤鬼、午金枪教主（五显灵官）马伤鬼、未伽蓝土地、申元帅将军伤司、酉佛象丧煞少女、戌土神犬伤鬼；外鬼带青龙三官大帝、内鬼带青龙水仙五圣；子鬼带玄武外为驿帝内为水伤

rule.yi: 亥是天门，和张壬作扰害；带青龙的象，宜叩拜三元；子是北斗，加上河伯作为灾殃；加了玄武的爻，应当酬谢圣帝；丑，是被牛顶撞的魂；寅，是被虎伤的鬼；卯，要禳解东岳；辰，要酬谢龙王；巳，推为火德尊星、被蛇所伤的鬼；午，断为金枪教主、被马踏的魂；未，叫伽蓝；申，说是元帅；酉，叫雌雄二煞；戌，遇上恶犬伤人。注说：亥鬼是张壬，就是祠山大帝；外鬼带青龙，是三官大帝；内鬼带青龙，是水仙五圣；子鬼是北斗、又是河伯水官，在外带玄武，是驿帝，在内带玄武，是水伤；丑鬼是土神，又是土伤之鬼；寅鬼是东岳，又是虎伤之鬼；卯鬼也是东岳；辰鬼是土神，又是龙王；巳鬼是火德星君和蚕室，又是蛇伤之鬼；午鬼是金枪教主，就是五显灵官，以及马伤之鬼；未鬼是土神，又是伽蓝土地；申鬼是元帅将军的职司和伤司，又有寺观中所冒犯的神；酉鬼是佛象和丧煞，又是少女；戌鬼是土神，又是犬伤之鬼。
rule.en: Hai is the Heavenly Gate and the harm done by Zhang Ren; with the image of the Azure Dragon, it is proper to appeal to the Three Primes; Zi is the Northern Dipper together with the River Count, as calamity; a line with the Dark Tortoise added should make offering to the Holy Emperor; Chou is the soul gored by an ox; Yin is the ghost wounded by a tiger; Mao: exorcise the Eastern Peak; Chen: thank the Dragon King; Si: work out the honoured Fire Virtue star and the ghost wounded by a snake; Wu: judge the Golden Spear Master and the soul trampled by a horse; Wei is called the Sangharama; Shen is said to be the Marshal; You is named the two killings, male and female; Xu meets a fierce dog wounding a person. The commentary says: the Hai ghost is Zhang Ren, that is, the Great Emperor of Ci Mountain; an outer ghost with the Azure Dragon is the Three Officials the Great Emperors; an inner ghost with the Azure Dragon is the Water Immortal and the Five Sages; a Zi ghost is the Northern Dipper and also the River Count and Water Official, and with the Dark Tortoise outside it is the Post Emperor, and inside it is the water injury; a Chou ghost is an earth spirit and also a ghost wounded by earth; a Yin ghost is the Eastern Peak and also a ghost wounded by a tiger; a Mao ghost is also the Eastern Peak; a Chen ghost is an earth spirit and also the Dragon King; a Si ghost is the Fire Virtue Star Lord and the silkworm house, and also a ghost wounded by a snake; a Wu ghost is the Golden Spear Master, that is, the Five Manifest Spirit Officials, and a ghost wounded by a horse; a Wei ghost is an earth spirit and also the Sangharama Earth God; a Shen ghost is the office of marshals and generals and the Injuring Office, and also a god offended in a temple or abbey; a You ghost is a Buddha image and the Mourning Killing, and also a young woman; a Xu ghost is an earth spirit and also a ghost wounded by a dog.

zh: 亥作天门及张壬之扰害。
带青龙之象，宜叩三元。
子为北斗兼河伯以为殃。
加玄武之爻当酬圣帝。
丑言牛触之魂，
寅是虎伤之鬼，
卯禳东岳，
辰谢龙王，
巳推火德尊星、蛇伤之鬼，
午断金枪教主、马踏之魂，
未曰伽蓝，
申云元帅，
酉命雌雄二煞，
戌逢恶犬伤人
yi: 亥是天门，和张壬作扰害；
带青龙的象，宜叩拜三元；
子是北斗，加上河伯作为灾殃；
加了玄武的爻，应当酬谢圣帝；
丑，是被牛顶撞的魂；
寅，是被虎伤的鬼；
卯，要禳解东岳；
辰，要酬谢龙王；
巳，推为火德尊星、被蛇所伤的鬼；
午，断为金枪教主、被马踏的魂；
未，叫伽蓝；
申，说是元帅；
酉，叫雌雄二煞；
戌，遇上恶犬伤人。
en: Hai is the Heavenly Gate and the harm done by Zhang Ren;
with the image of the Azure Dragon, it is proper to appeal to the Three Primes;
Zi is the Northern Dipper together with the River Count, as calamity;
a line with the Dark Tortoise added should make offering to the Holy Emperor;
Chou is the soul gored by an ox;
Yin is the ghost wounded by a tiger;
Mao: exorcise the Eastern Peak;
Chen: thank the Dragon King;
Si: work out the honoured Fire Virtue star and the ghost wounded by a snake;
Wu: judge the Golden Spear Master and the soul trampled by a horse;
Wei is called the Sangharama;
Shen is said to be the Marshal;
You is named the two killings, male and female;
Xu meets a fierce dog wounding a person.

zh: 亥鬼为张壬，即祠山大帝。
外鬼带青龙，为三官大帝；
内鬼带青龙，为水仙五圣。
子鬼为北斗、又为河伯水官，在外带玄武，为驿帝，在内带玄武，为水伤。
丑鬼为土神，又为土伤之鬼。
寅鬼为东岳、又为虎伤之鬼。
卯鬼亦为东岳，辰鬼土神、又为龙王。
巳鬼为火德星君并蚕室、又为蛇伤之鬼。
午鬼为金枪教主，即五显灵官、并马伤之鬼。
未鬼为土神，又为伽蓝土地，申鬼为元帅将军之职并伤司，又有寺观中所犯之神。
酉鬼为佛象并丧煞、又为少女。
戌鬼为土神，又为犬伤之鬼。
yi: 亥鬼是张壬，就是祠山大帝。
外鬼带青龙，是三官大帝；
内鬼带青龙，是水仙五圣。
子鬼是北斗、又是河伯水官，在外带玄武，是驿帝，在内带玄武，是水伤。
丑鬼是土神，又是土伤之鬼。
寅鬼是东岳，又是虎伤之鬼。
卯鬼也是东岳；辰鬼是土神，又是龙王。
巳鬼是火德星君和蚕室，又是蛇伤之鬼。
午鬼是金枪教主，就是五显灵官，以及马伤之鬼。
未鬼是土神，又是伽蓝土地；申鬼是元帅将军的职司和伤司，又有寺观中所冒犯的神。
酉鬼是佛象和丧煞，又是少女。
戌鬼是土神，又是犬伤之鬼。
en: The Hai ghost is Zhang Ren, that is, the Great Emperor of Ci Mountain.
An outer ghost with the Azure Dragon is the Three Officials the Great Emperors;
an inner ghost with the Azure Dragon is the Water Immortal and the Five Sages.
A Zi ghost is the Northern Dipper and also the River Count and Water Official, and with the Dark Tortoise outside it is the Post Emperor, and inside it is the water injury.
A Chou ghost is an earth spirit and also a ghost wounded by earth.
A Yin ghost is the Eastern Peak and also a ghost wounded by a tiger.
A Mao ghost is also the Eastern Peak; a Chen ghost is an earth spirit and also the Dragon King.
A Si ghost is the Fire Virtue Star Lord and the silkworm house, and also a ghost wounded by a snake.
A Wu ghost is the Golden Spear Master, that is, the Five Manifest Spirit Officials, and a ghost wounded by a horse.
A Wei ghost is an earth spirit and also the Sangharama Earth God; a Shen ghost is the office of marshals and generals and the Injuring Office, and also a god offended in a temple or abbey.
A You ghost is a Buddha image and the Mourning Killing, and also a young woman.
A Xu ghost is an earth spirit and also a ghost wounded by a dog.

note.yi: 这一节前半是歌诀（到「戌逢恶犬伤人」），后半是解说（从「亥鬼为张壬」起）；原文两半接在同一行里没有断开，这里按内容分成两段引文。「亥鬼为张壬」一句在原文里紧接「戌逢恶犬伤人」，是解说的第一句。十二支各配一位或几位神鬼，大体的路数和易冒「按十二支断神鬼」（LY.ILL.YM.61）一致：亥子是水神（天门、北斗、河伯），寅卯是东岳，巳午是火德、金枪教主（五显），辰戌丑未是土神，申酉是元帅、佛象；又和黄金策旧注的「刑不善终」按地支分（LY.ILL.HJC.103：辰压死、午汤火烫、酉刀箭、亥落水、寅虎噬、巳蛇伤）相通：寅虎伤、巳蛇伤、午马伤、戌犬伤都是各支所属的动物。「驿帝」「水伤」「元帅将军之职并伤司」按字面译。这一段里神、鬼、星煞的名字，是吴地的民间神祇和星煞，书里没有解释，这里按字面译或音译，不作认定。
note.en: The first half of this section is a verse (down to 'Xu meets a fierce dog wounding a person') and the second half explanation (from 'the Hai ghost is Zhang Ren'); in the original the two halves run on in the same line without a break, and they are made into two quotations here by content. The sentence 'the Hai ghost is Zhang Ren' follows 'Xu meets a fierce dog wounding a person' directly in the original and is the first sentence of the explanation. Each of the twelve branches is paired with one or several gods and ghosts, in the same general way as the Yi Mao's 'reading ghosts and spirits by the twelve branches' (LY.ILL.YM.61): Hai and Zi are water gods (the Heavenly Gate, the Northern Dipper, the River Count), Yin and Mao are the Eastern Peak, Si and Wu are the Fire Virtue and the Golden Spear Master (the Five Manifest), Chen, Xu, Chou and Wei are earth spirits, and Shen and You are the Marshal and the Buddha image; it also links with the old commentary of the Huangjin Ce on 'not dying a good death' by branch (LY.ILL.HJC.103: Chen crushed to death, Wu scalded or burned, You blade and arrow, Hai drowned, Yin bitten by a tiger, Si bitten by a snake): Yin the tiger, Si the snake, Wu the horse and Xu the dog are all the animals belonging to each branch. 'The Post Emperor', 'the water injury' and 'the office of marshals and generals and the Injuring Office' are translated literally. Names of gods, spirits and stars in this passage are given by transliteration or plain rendering; they are cults and stars of the Wu region that the book does not explain, and none is identified here beyond what the book says.

units.chapter_en: Chapter 74: Searching out ghosts and spirits
units.title: 按爻位断神鬼：六爻上仓至圣坟墓之神（素原、坟墓土神、远方之鬼）、五爻中界至尊东岳（栏路五圣五路大神倒路之鬼）、四爻大小伤神右仪门将军（门前鬼）、三爻家堂郡王府城隍（床婆弟兄鬼房内鬼桥上鬼）、二爻县城隍灶神（夫妻鬼厨下鬼）、初爻土地井泉童子（井前之鬼、无井即土鬼）

rule.yi: 六爻，是上仓的至圣、坟墓的神；五爻，是中界的至尊、路途的鬼；四爻，推为檐外伤、朝门前的魍魉；三爻断，鬼在六爻，是上苍的素原、以及坟墓土神、或远方的鬼；鬼在五爻，是中界至尊，就是东岳，又是栏路五圣、五路大神、或倒在路上的鬼；鬼在四爻，是大小伤神、以及右仪门的将军、又是门前的鬼；鬼在三爻，是家堂和郡王，就是府城隍，又是床婆、弟兄的鬼，以及房内的鬼、桥上的鬼；鬼在二爻，是县城隍和灶神，又是夫妻等的鬼、厨下的鬼；鬼在初爻，是土地和井泉童子、以及井前的鬼，如果没有井，就是土鬼。
rule.en: The sixth line is the supreme sage of the upper granary and the god of graves; the fifth is the supreme honoured one of the middle realm and the ghost of the road; the fourth is worked out as an injury beyond the eaves and the goblins before the court gate; the third judge: a ghost on the sixth line is the plain vow of the upper heaven, the earth god of graves, or a ghost from a far place; a ghost on the fifth line is the supreme honoured one of the middle realm, that is, the Eastern Peak, and also the Five Sages of the barrier road, the Great God of the Five Roads, or a ghost fallen on the road; a ghost on the fourth line is the greater and lesser Injuring gods, and the general at the right ceremonial gate, and also a ghost before the door; a ghost on the third line is the household shrine and the Prince of the Commandery, that is, the City God of the prefecture, and also the Bed Mother and a ghost of brothers, and a ghost within the room and a ghost on the bridge; a ghost on the second line is the City God of the county and the Kitchen God, and also a ghost of husband and wife and a ghost beneath the kitchen; a ghost on the first line is the Earth God and the Well-and-Spring Boy, and a ghost before the well, and if there is no well it is an earth ghost.

zh: 六乃上仓至圣、坟墓之神。
五为中界至尊、路途之鬼。
四推檐外伤朝门前魍魉。
yi: 六爻，是上仓的至圣、坟墓的神。
五爻，是中界的至尊、路途的鬼。
四爻，推为檐外伤、朝门前的魍魉。
en: The sixth line is the supreme sage of the upper granary and the god of graves.
The fifth is the supreme honoured one of the middle realm and the ghost of the road.
The fourth is worked out as an injury beyond the eaves and the goblins before the court gate.

zh: 三断鬼在六爻，为上苍素原、并坟墓土神、或远方之鬼。
鬼在五爻为中界至尊、即东岳也，又为栏路五圣、并五路大神、或倒路之鬼。
鬼在四爻为大小伤神、并在右仪门将军、又为门前之鬼。
鬼在三爻，为家堂并郡王，即府城隍，又为床婆弟兄鬼，及房内鬼、桥上鬼。
鬼在二爻为县城隍并灶神，又为夫妻等鬼、厨下鬼。
鬼在初爻，为土地并井泉童子，并井前之鬼，如无井即土鬼。
yi: 三爻断：鬼在六爻，是上苍的素原、以及坟墓土神、或远方的鬼。
鬼在五爻，是中界至尊，就是东岳，又是栏路五圣、五路大神、或倒在路上的鬼。
鬼在四爻，是大小伤神、以及右仪门的将军、又是门前的鬼。
鬼在三爻，是家堂和郡王，就是府城隍，又是床婆、弟兄的鬼，以及房内的鬼、桥上的鬼。
鬼在二爻，是县城隍和灶神，又是夫妻等的鬼、厨下的鬼。
鬼在初爻，是土地和井泉童子、以及井前的鬼，如果没有井，就是土鬼。
en: The third judge: a ghost on the sixth line is the plain vow of the upper heaven, the earth god of graves, or a ghost from a far place.

A ghost on the fifth line is the supreme honoured one of the middle realm, that is, the Eastern Peak, and also the Five Sages of the barrier road, the Great God of the Five Roads, or a ghost fallen on the road.
A ghost on the fourth line is the greater and lesser Injuring gods, and the general at the right ceremonial gate, and also a ghost before the door.

A ghost on the third line is the household shrine and the Prince of the Commandery, that is, the City God of the prefecture, and also the Bed Mother and a ghost of brothers, and a ghost within the room and a ghost on the bridge.
A ghost on the second line is the City God of the county and the Kitchen God, and also a ghost of husband and wife and a ghost beneath the kitchen.
A ghost on the first line is the Earth God and the Well-and-Spring Boy, and a ghost before the well, and if there is no well it is an earth ghost.

note.yi: 这一段歌诀只剩三句（六、五、四爻），第四句「三断」之后原文没有接歌诀，而是直接接解说「鬼在六爻」，所以「三断」这两个字看起来是歌诀残留，这里和解说的第一句连在一起引。第一位「上仓至圣」「素原」的「素原」是素食所许的愿（见 LY.ILL.HJC.93 后各条的「素愿」）。这一节的爻位配法和易冒「按爻位断神鬼」（LY.ILL.YM.58）、黄金策「六爻推鬼神」（LY.ILL.HJC.101）大体同路：初爻井、二爻灶、三爻家堂、五爻路、六爻坟墓；差别是易林补遗每爻多列了具体的神名和几种鬼。「床婆」是保护婴孩的床神。这一段里神、鬼、星煞的名字，是吴地的民间神祇和星煞，书里没有解释，这里按字面译或音译，不作认定。
note.en: The verse of this passage is left with only three lines (the sixth, fifth and fourth lines), and after 'the third judge' the original does not go on with verse but goes straight into the explanation 'a ghost on the sixth line', so that 'the third judge' looks like a remnant of the verse and is quoted here joined to the first sentence of the explanation. 'Plain vow' is a vow made with vegetarian offering. The assignment by line position agrees in outline with the Yi Mao's 'reading ghosts and spirits by line position' (LY.ILL.YM.58) and the Huangjin Ce's 'reading ghosts and spirits by the six lines' (LY.ILL.HJC.101): the first line the well, the second the stove, the third the household shrine, the fifth the road, the sixth the graves; the difference is that the Yilin Buyi lists specific gods and several kinds of ghost for each line. The 'Bed Mother' is the bed goddess who protects infants. Names of gods, spirits and stars in this passage are given by transliteration or plain rendering; they are cults and stars of the Wu region that the book does not explain, and none is identified here beyond what the book says.

units.chapter_en: Chapter 74: Searching out ghosts and spirits
units.title: 官临世上按爻位断神：鬼持世于初爻家堂作祸、二爻社坛作祟、三爻犯桥道之鬼或园中花木之精、四爻犯五道及师王佛实之灾、五爻无鬼不言、六爻山神为害及星宿降灾；鬼值空中莫断片殃之祟

rule.yi: 官鬼临在世爻上，要注明六象的神；鬼落在空亡中，不要断作哪一份殃祟。注说：鬼在初爻持世，是家堂作祸；鬼在二爻持世，上气为实，并且是社坛作祟；鬼在三爻持世，是冒犯了桥道中的鬼，如果不是桥道，就是园中花木的精怪；鬼在四爻持世，是冒犯了五道，也有师王佛实的灾；鬼在五爻持世，原文说没有（可说的）不言；鬼在六爻持世，是山神为害，以及星宿降灾；六爻里鬼虽然持世，落空了就不说。
rule.en: The Pressure line on the Self line: note the spirits of the six images; a ghost in Void: do not judge a haunting of any part of calamity. The commentary says: a ghost on the first line holding the Self is the household shrine making trouble; a ghost on the second holding the Self, the upper qi is real, and the altar of the soil haunts; a ghost on the third holding the Self offends the ghost of a bridge or road, and if not a bridge or road, it is the spirit of garden flowers and trees; a ghost on the fourth holding the Self offends the Five Roads, and there is also calamity from teachers, kings and Buddhas (the text says 'shi'); with the fifth, if there is no ghost, nothing is said; a ghost on the sixth holding the Self is the Mountain God doing harm and stars descending calamity; though the ghost in the six lines holds the Self, if it is Void nothing is said.

zh: 官临世上，注开六象之神。
鬼值空中，莫断片殃之祟。
yi: 官鬼临在世爻上，要注明六象的神。
鬼落在空亡中，不要断作哪一份殃祟。
en: The Pressure line on the Self line: note the spirits of the six images.
A ghost in Void: do not judge a haunting of any part of calamity.

zh: 鬼值初爻持世，家堂作祸，鬼值二世，上气为实、并社坛作祟。
鬼值三世，犯桥道中之鬼，若非桥道，即是园中花木之精。
鬼值四世，犯五道亦有师王佛实之灾。
五世无鬼不言。
鬼值六世，山神为害，及星宿降灾。
六爻内鬼虽持世，空则不言。
yi: 鬼在初爻持世，是家堂作祸；鬼在二爻持世，上气为实，并且是社坛作祟。
鬼在三爻持世，是冒犯了桥道中的鬼，如果不是桥道，就是园中花木的精怪。
鬼在四爻持世，是冒犯了五道，也有师王佛实的灾。
五爻（持世），没有鬼就不说。
鬼在六爻持世，是山神为害，以及星宿降灾。
六爻里鬼虽然持世，落空了就不说。
en: A ghost on the first line holding the Self is the household shrine making trouble; a ghost on the second holding the Self, the upper qi is real, and the altar of the soil haunts.
A ghost on the third line holding the Self offends the ghost of a bridge or road, and if not a bridge or road, it is the spirit of garden flowers and trees.
A ghost on the fourth line holding the Self offends the Five Roads, and there is also calamity from teachers, kings and Buddhas (the text says 'shi').
With the fifth, if there is no ghost, nothing is said.
A ghost on the sixth line holding the Self is the Mountain God doing harm and stars descending calamity.
Though the ghost in the six lines holds the Self, if it is Void nothing is said.

note.yi: 这一节和易冒「世于初者，家神也，世于二者，土神也……」（LY.ILL.YM.58）是同一件事：鬼持世时，看世在哪一爻。易林补遗的配法：初家堂、二社坛、三桥道或园中花木之精、四五道及师王佛、五爻不言、六山神及星宿。「上气为实」「师王佛实」两处原文没有解释，读法没有把握，这里按字面译。「六象之神」指上一节（LY.ILL.EL.37）里六个爻位各配的神。这一段里神、鬼、星煞的名字，是吴地的民间神祇和星煞，书里没有解释，这里按字面译或音译，不作认定。
note.en: This section is the same matter as the Yi Mao's 'the Self on the first line is a household spirit, on the second an earth spirit...' (LY.ILL.YM.58): when the ghost holds the Self, look at which line the Self is on. The Yilin Buyi's assignments: the first the household shrine, the second the altar of the soil, the third a bridge or road or the spirit of garden flowers and trees, the fourth the Five Roads and teachers, kings and Buddhas, the fifth left unsaid, the sixth the Mountain God and the stars. 'The upper qi is real' and 'teachers, kings and Buddhas (shi)' are not explained in the original, the reading is uncertain, and they are translated literally. 'The spirits of the six images' means the gods paired with the six line positions in the previous section (LY.ILL.EL.37). Names of gods, spirits and stars in this passage are given by transliteration or plain rendering; they are cults and stars of the Wu region that the book does not explain, and none is identified here beyond what the book says.

units.chapter_en: Chapter 74: Searching out ghosts and spirits
units.title: 青龙临财、玄武临福化出官爻必是福神见咎（大则五福茶延、小则五圣五路）；朱雀临父母变出鬼爻必是先年许下之愿；居兑卦又犯天曹；判鬼神须审病源轻重，重则大神轻则小祟

rule.yi: 青龙、财爻、子孙变出官爻，是福神来照应；兑宫、朱雀、文书变成鬼象，是先前许的愿在催。注说：青龙如果临财、玄武临福（子孙），变出官爻，必是福神见咎；福神，大的是五福和茶延，小的是五圣和五路；凡是判断鬼神，必须审察病源的轻重，重的就是大神，轻的就是小祟；再看朱雀临父母变出鬼爻，必是先年许下的愿；如果落在兑卦，又是冒犯了天曹。
rule.en: The Azure Dragon, Wealth and Output changing into a Pressure line: the fortune spirit shines on it; Dui, the Vermilion Bird and the writing image becoming a ghost image: the earlier vow presses. The commentary says: if the Azure Dragon sits on Wealth and the Dark Tortoise on Output (the fortune spirit) and it changes into a Pressure line, it is surely Output (the fortune spirit) showing fault; the fortune spirit, at the great end, is the Five Blessings and the Tea Feast, and at the small end the Five Sages and the Five Roads; in judging ghosts and spirits one must examine the lightness or weight of the source of the illness, the heavy being a great god and the light a small haunting; look further at the Vermilion Bird on the Resource line changing into a Pressure line, which is surely a vow made in a former year; if it sits in the Dui hexagram, it is again an offence against the Heavenly Bureau.

zh: 青龙财子化官爻，福神相照。
兑雀文书之鬼象，前愿相催。
yi: 青龙、财爻、子孙变出官爻，是福神来照应；
兑宫、朱雀、文书变成鬼象，是先前许的愿在催。
en: The Azure Dragon, Wealth and Output changing into a Pressure line: Output (the fortune spirit) shines on it;
Dui, the Vermilion Bird and the writing image becoming a ghost image: the earlier vow presses.

zh: 青龙若临财武临福化出官爻，必是福神见咎。
福神者，大则五福及茶延，小则五圣及五路。
凡判鬼神，须审病源轻重，重则大神，轻则小祟。
复看朱雀临父母变出鬼爻，必是先年许下之愿。
若居兑卦，又犯天曹。
yi: 青龙如果临财、玄武临福（子孙），变出官爻，必是福神见咎。
福神，大的是五福和茶延，小的是五圣和五路。
凡是判断鬼神，必须审察病源的轻重，重的就是大神，轻的就是小祟。
再看朱雀临父母变出鬼爻，必是先年许下的愿。
如果落在兑卦，又是冒犯了天曹。
en: If the Azure Dragon sits on Wealth and the Dark Tortoise on Output (the fortune spirit) and it changes into a Pressure line, it is surely Output (the fortune spirit) showing fault.
The fortune spirit, at the great end, is the Five Blessings and the Tea Feast, and at the small end the Five Sages and the Five Roads (as Output).
In judging ghosts and spirits one must examine the lightness or weight of the source of the illness, the heavy being a great god and the light a small haunting.
Look further at the Vermilion Bird on the Resource line changing into a Pressure line, which is surely a vow made in a former year.
If it sits in the Dui hexagram, it is again an offence against the Heavenly Bureau.

note.yi: 「福神」在这里是子孙（福神就是子孙）。「福神见咎」是本来带福的六亲（青龙财、玄武福）变出官爻，成了作祟的鬼——所以是福神要求还愿，而不是凶鬼。「大则五福及茶延，小则五圣及五路」是说福神的大小：大神（五福、茶延）和小神（五圣、五路）；判断时按病源轻重取大神或小祟。「先年许下之愿」是以前许过没还的愿，朱雀是口舌，父母是文书誓约，所以是口头许过的愿；与 LY.ILL.EL.35 前一节不同，与易隐鬼崇·旧愿（LY.ILL.YY.32）、黄金策「鬼持世是旧愿未酬」（LY.ILL.HJC.110）是同一件事。这一段里神、鬼、星煞的名字，是吴地的民间神祇和星煞，书里没有解释，这里按字面译或音译，不作认定。
note.en: 'Fortune spirit' here is Output (the fortune spirit is Output). 'The fortune spirit showing fault' is when a relation that would bring fortune (Wealth on the Azure Dragon, Output on the Dark Tortoise) changes into a Pressure line and becomes a haunting ghost — so it is the fortune spirit demanding the redemption of a vow, and not an evil ghost. 'At the great end the Five Blessings and the Tea Feast, at the small end the Five Sages and the Five Roads' speaks of the size of the fortune spirit: great gods (the Five Blessings, the Tea Feast) and small gods (the Five Sages, the Five Roads); in judging one takes a great god or a small haunting by the weight of the source of the illness. 'A vow made in a former year' is an earlier vow made and not redeemed: the Vermilion Bird is talk, and the Resource line is documents and oaths, so it is a vow spoken aloud; it is the same matter as the Yi Yin's 'ghosts and hauntings: old vows' (LY.ILL.YY.32) and the Huangjin Ce's 'a ghost holding the Self is an old vow unpaid' (LY.ILL.HJC.110). Names of gods, spirits and stars in this passage are given by transliteration or plain rendering; they are cults and stars of the Wu region that the book does not explain, and none is identified here beyond what the book says.

units.chapter_en: Chapter 74: Searching out ghosts and spirits
units.title: 六亲内外动断是谁的鬼：父母内动本宗祠堂宗相、外动外族高亲；财内动先亡妻妾（妻魂妾魄）、外动奴仆或情人；兄动手足相知之辈（昆弟姨妹朋友）；福动儿孙之鬼、僧道之灵（儿女侄婿）

rule.yi: 父母爻在内发动，才断祠堂里的宗相；父母爻在外发动，可以说是外族的高亲；财爻在内宫动，必是妻子的魂、妾的魄；妻财在外卦摇动，不是奴仆就是情人；兄弟发动，是手足之亲、相知的人；子孙发动，是儿孙的鬼，僧道的灵。注说：父爻在内卦以及在亲宫动的，就说是本宗的尊长；父爻居外卦以及在他宫动的，就说是外姓的尊亲；财爻临内卦或在亲宫动的，必是先亡的妻妾；财爻在他宫以及外卦动的，如果不是奴仆，必是恩爱的情人；兄弟动的，或是兄弟、或是姨妹、或是朋友的魂；子孙动的，是儿女、是侄、是女婿，又是僧道的魂。
rule.en: The Resource line moving inside is judged the ancestral image of the ancestral hall; the Resource line moving outside may be called a high relative of another clan; Wealth moving in the inner palace is surely a wife's spirit and a concubine's soul; Wealth stirring in the outer trigram is either a servant or a lover; Peer thriving is a kin of hand and foot, an intimate; Output moving is the ghost of sons and grandsons, the spirit of a monk or Daoist. The commentary says: the Resource line moving in the inner trigram or in a kin palace is called an elder of one's own line; the Resource line in the outer trigram or moving in another palace is a revered kinsman of another surname; Wealth in the inner trigram or moving in a kin palace is surely a wife or concubine who died earlier; Wealth in another palace or moving in the outer trigram, if not a servant, is surely a loving sweetheart; when Peer moves, it is the spirit of a brother, or an aunt or sister, or a friend; when Output moves, it is a son or daughter, a nephew, a son-in-law, and also the spirit of a monk or Daoist.

zh: 父母内兴，方断祠堂之宗相；
椿萱外动，可言外族之高亲。
财动内宫，必妻魂而妾魄；
妻摇外卦，非奴仆即情人。
兄兴为手足之亲、相知之辈；
福动乃儿孙之鬼，僧道之灵。
yi: 父母爻在内发动，才断祠堂里的宗相；
父母爻在外发动，可以说是外族的高亲；
财爻在内宫动，必是妻子的魂、妾的魄；
妻财在外卦摇动，不是奴仆就是情人；
兄弟发动，是手足之亲、相知的人；
子孙发动，是儿孙的鬼，僧道的灵。
en: The Resource line moving inside is judged the ancestral image of the ancestral hall;
the Resource line moving outside may be called a high relative of another clan;
Wealth moving in the inner palace is surely a wife's spirit and a concubine's soul;
Wealth stirring in the outer trigram is either a servant or a lover;
Peer thriving is a kin of hand and foot, an intimate;
Output moving is the ghost of sons and grandsons, the spirit of a monk or Daoist.

zh: 父在内卦及亲宫动者，便曰本宗之尊长。
父居外卦及他宫动者，乃言外姓之尊亲。
财临内卦或亲宫动者，必先亡之妻妾。
财值他宫及外卦动者，若非奴仆，必恩爱之情人。
兄弟动者，或昆弟或姨妹或朋友之魂。
子孙动者，为儿女为侄为婿，又为僧道之魂。
yi: 父爻在内卦以及在亲宫动的，就说是本宗的尊长。
父爻居外卦以及在他宫动的，就说是外姓的尊亲。
财爻临内卦或在亲宫动的，必是先亡的妻妾。
财爻在他宫以及外卦动的，如果不是奴仆，必是恩爱的情人。
兄弟动的，或是兄弟、或是姨妹、或是朋友的魂。
子孙动的，是儿女、是侄、是女婿，又是僧道的魂。
en: The Resource line moving in the inner trigram or in a kin palace is called an elder of one's own line.
The Resource line in the outer trigram or moving in another palace is a revered kinsman of another surname.
Wealth in the inner trigram or moving in a kin palace is surely a wife or concubine who died earlier.
Wealth in another palace or moving in the outer trigram, if not a servant, is surely a loving sweetheart.
When Peer moves, it is the spirit of a brother, or an aunt or sister, or a friend.
When Output moves, it is a son or daughter, a nephew, a son-in-law, and also the spirit of a monk or Daoist.

note.yi: 这一节和易冒「按六亲断神鬼」（LY.ILL.YM.60）、黄金策「以卦身推是什么人的鬼」和「鬼动化出六亲即以化出者断」（LY.ILL.HJC.102、HJC.108）是同一件事。易林补遗比易冒多了一个内外的分法：父母爻在内卦、亲宫是本宗的，在外卦、他宫是外姓的；财爻在内是先亡的妻妾，在外是奴仆或情人。「亲宫」是本宫（与卦同宫的爻所在的宫）。「椿萱」是父母的雅称，原文这里用在歌诀里。
note.en: This section is the same matter as the Yi Mao's 'reading ghosts and spirits by the six relations' (LY.ILL.YM.60) and the Huangjin Ce's 'reading whose ghost it is from the Body' and 'a ghost moving into a relation is judged by what it turns into' (LY.ILL.HJC.102, HJC.108). The Yilin Buyi adds a division into inner and outer beyond the Yi Mao: the Resource line in the inner trigram or a kin palace is of one's own line, and in the outer trigram or another palace of another surname; Wealth inside is a wife or concubine who died earlier, and outside a servant or a lover. A 'kin palace' is the home palace (the palace to which the hexagram belongs). 'Chun-xuan' is a polite name for parents and is used here in the verse.

units.chapter_en: Chapter 74: Searching out ghosts and spirits
units.title: 卦有动爻病有鬼魅：一爻动一魂、两爻动两鬼、三爻动三魂、四爻动四鬼；定阴阳（重单为男、交折为女）；鬼食荤素（子孙及青龙爻动宜素祭、其余爻动荤素皆合）；定方向（子爻动正北方鬼、丑爻动东北方鬼，卯东酉西）

rule.yi: 卦里有动爻，病里就有鬼魅：比如三爻动，就是三个魂，四个象兴动就是四个鬼。要定阴阳，重、单是男，交、折是女；要分方向，卯动是东方，酉动是西方。注说：凡是推儿官，专看动爻，一爻动就是一个魂，两爻动就是两个鬼；想分男女，要看阴阳，重的是男，交的是女；想知道鬼吃荤还是吃素，只有子孙和青龙爻动的，都宜用素祭，其余的爻动，一概荤素都合；想知道鬼在哪个方位，就看动在哪一象：比如子爻动，是正北方的鬼；丑爻动，是东北方的鬼；其余照这样推。
rule.en: Where the hexagram has moving lines, the illness has ghosts and sprites: for example, if the third line moves, there are three souls, and if four images stir, four ghosts. To fix yin and yang, the double and the single are male, the crossed and the broken are female; to divide the direction, a moving Mao is east and a moving You is west. The commentary says: in working out a child-official, look only at the moving lines: one line moving is one soul, two lines moving are two ghosts; to divide male and female, look at yin and yang, the double being male and the crossed female; to know whether the ghost eats meat or vegetables, only when Output or the Azure Dragon line moves is a vegetarian offering suitable, and when any other line moves, both meat and vegetarian suit; to know in which direction the ghost is, look at which image it moves in: for example, a moving Zi line is a ghost of the due north, and a moving Chou line a ghost of the northeast; the rest follow this.

zh: 卦有动爻，病有鬼魅。
且如三爻动，则三魂，四象兴而四鬼。
若定阴阳，重单是男交折女。
如分方向，卯动东方酉动西。
yi: 卦里有动爻，病里就有鬼魅。
比如三爻动，就是三个魂，四个象兴动就是四个鬼。
要定阴阳，重、单是男，交、折是女；
要分方向，卯动是东方，酉动是西方。
en: Where the hexagram has moving lines, the illness has ghosts and sprites.
For example, if the third line moves, there are three souls, and if four images stir, four ghosts.
To fix yin and yang, the double and the single are male, the crossed and the broken are female;
to divide the direction, a moving Mao is east and a moving You is west.

zh: 凡推儿官，专看动爻，一爻动则一魂。
两爻动，则两鬼。
欲分男女，须看阴阳。
重则为男交则为女。
要知鬼食荤素，惟有子孙及青龙爻动者，皆宜素祭，其余爻动，概合荤素。
要知鬼在何方，却看动临何象。
且如子爻动，正北方之鬼，丑爻动，东北方之鬼，其余仿此。
yi: 凡是推儿官，专看动爻，一爻动就是一个魂。
两爻动，就是两个鬼。
想分男女，要看阴阳。
重的是男，交的是女。
想知道鬼吃荤还是吃素，只有子孙和青龙爻动的，都宜用素祭，其余的爻动，一概荤素都合。
想知道鬼在哪个方位，就看动在哪一象。
比如子爻动，是正北方的鬼；丑爻动，是东北方的鬼；其余照这样推。
en: In working out a child-official, look only at the moving lines: one line moving is one soul.
Two lines moving are two ghosts.
To divide male and female, look at yin and yang.
The double is male and the crossed is female.
To know whether the ghost eats meat or vegetables, only when Output or the Azure Dragon line moves is a vegetarian offering suitable, and when any other line moves, both meat and vegetarian suit.
To know in which direction the ghost is, look at which image it moves in.
For example, a moving Zi line is a ghost of the due north, and a moving Chou line a ghost of the northeast; the rest follow this.

note.yi: 「重、单、交、折」是摇卦时四种爻的名称：重（老阳）、单（少阳）是阳，交（老阴）、折（少阴）是阴，所以歌诀说重、单是男，交、折是女；解说只说「重则为男，交则为女」，是说动的爻（重是动的阳、交是动的阴）。「儿官」原文没有解释，疑是「鬼」的别称（「官」是官鬼），这里按字面译作「child-official」并保留；「一爻动则一魂」是数动爻的条数当作魂数，这和易冒「以动爻当鬼、一动一鬼、三动三鬼」（LY.ILL.YM.54）是同一件事。「子孙及青龙爻动者宜素祭」是说这类鬼（子孙、青龙）偏于善神，用素祭。
note.en: 'Double, single, crossed, broken' are the names of the four kinds of line in casting: the double (old yang) and the single (young yang) are yang, and the crossed (old yin) and the broken (young yin) are yin, so the verse says the double and the single are male and the crossed and the broken female; the explanation says only 'the double is male, the crossed female', speaking of the moving lines (the double being a moving yang and the crossed a moving yin). 'Child-official' (er guan) is not explained in the original and looks like another name for the ghost ('guan' being the Pressure line); it is translated literally and kept. 'One line moving is one soul' counts the number of moving lines as the number of souls, the same matter as the Yi Mao's 'take the moving lines as the ghosts, one moving one ghost, three moving three ghosts' (LY.ILL.YM.54). 'Output or the Azure Dragon line moving suits a vegetarian offering' means that these kinds of ghost (Output and the Azure Dragon) lean toward benevolent spirits, and take a vegetarian offering.

units.chapter_en: Chapter 74: Searching out ghosts and spirits
units.title: 卦静当寻外象、无官另看伏神：卦无动爻只取外卦（外乾病从西北、外坤祸起西南）；内外皆无官鬼则看鬼伏何爻之下、鬼上飞神定其所向（颐卦伏三爻飞神庚辰为东南、讼卦伏三爻午火为南）；伏鬼再空莫言祸祟

rule.yi: 卦安静，就该找外卦的象；没有官鬼，另外看伏神；鬼上面的飞爻，方向就定下来了。注说：卦里没有动爻，只取外卦：比如外卦属乾宫，病就从西北来；外卦临坤，祸就起在西南；六爻内有鬼的，这样来看。内外都没有官鬼，又不取外卦为凭据，另外去找鬼伏在哪一爻之下，由鬼上面的飞神来定它的方向：假如占得颐卦安静，鬼伏在三爻之下，就取飞神庚辰，辰是东南方，断定一定没有差错；又如讼卦安静，鬼也伏在三爻午火之下，就说是南方；伏鬼再落空，就不要说是祸祟。
rule.en: When the hexagram is still, look for the image of the outer trigram; if there is no Pressure line, look separately at the hidden line; the flying line above the ghost fixes the direction again. The commentary says: if the hexagram has no moving line, take only the outer trigram: for example, if the outer belongs to the Qian palace, the illness comes from the northwest; if the outer sits on Kun, misfortune rises in the southwest; where there is a ghost among the six lines, look at it so. If neither inner nor outer has a Pressure line, and one does not rely on the outer trigram, look separately under which line the ghost lies hidden, and fix its direction by the flying line above the ghost: if, for example, a still Yi is obtained with the ghost hidden under the third line, take the flying line Gengchen, Chen being the southeast, and the judgment will surely not err; or in a still Song the ghost is also hidden under the third line, Wu Fire, and one says south; if the hidden ghost is again Void, do not speak of haunting.

zh: 卦静当寻外象，无官另看伏神。
鬼上飞爻，其方又定。
yi: 卦安静，就该找外卦的象；没有官鬼，另外看伏神。
鬼上面的飞爻，方向就定下来了。
en: When the hexagram is still, look for the image of the outer trigram; if there is no Pressure line, look separately at the hidden line.
The flying line above the ghost fixes the direction again.

zh: 卦无动爻，只取外卦。
且如外属乾宫，则病从西北。
外临坤卦，则祸起西南。
六爻内有鬼者，如此看之。
内外皆无官鬼，又不取外卦为凭，另寻鬼伏何爻之下，鬼上飞神定其所向。
假令卜得颐卦安静，鬼伏三爻之下，便取飞神庚辰上，辰者，东南之向，断必无差。
又如讼卦安静，鬼亦伏在三爻午火之下，便曰南方，伏鬼再空，莫言祸祟。
yi: 卦里没有动爻，只取外卦。
比如外卦属乾宫，病就从西北来。
外卦临坤，祸就起在西南。
六爻内有鬼的，这样来看。
内外都没有官鬼，又不取外卦为凭据，另外去找鬼伏在哪一爻之下，由鬼上面的飞神来定它的方向。
假如占得颐卦安静，鬼伏在三爻之下，就取飞神庚辰，辰是东南方，断定一定没有差错。
又如讼卦安静，鬼也伏在三爻午火之下，就说是南方；伏鬼再落空，就不要说是祸祟。
en: If the hexagram has no moving line, take only the outer trigram.
For example, if the outer belongs to the Qian palace, the illness comes from the northwest.
If the outer sits on Kun, misfortune rises in the southwest.
Where there is a ghost among the six lines, look at it so.

If neither inner nor outer has a Pressure line, and one does not rely on the outer trigram, look separately under which line the ghost lies hidden, and fix its direction by the flying line above the ghost.
If, for example, a still Yi is obtained with the ghost hidden under the third line, take the flying line Gengchen, Chen being the southeast, and the judgment will surely not err.
Or in a still Song the ghost is also hidden under the third line, Wu Fire, and one says south; if the hidden ghost is again Void, do not speak of haunting.

note.yi: 这一条与本章「何处得病」（LY.ILL.EL.03）最后一段几乎是同一段话，只是那里问的是病从哪里起，这里问的是作祟的鬼在哪个方向。颐卦（卦名）的例：鬼（官鬼，金）伏在三爻之下，三爻的飞神是庚辰，辰属东南；讼卦的例与 LY.ILL.EL.03 相同（鬼伏三爻午火之下，南方）。和易冒「考鬼的四种情形」（LY.ILL.YM.55）、「病从何起」（LY.ILL.YM.29）、易隐「病起何方」（LY.ILL.YY.33）是同一套办法。「六爻内有鬼者，如此看之」是说卦里有鬼、也没有动爻时，才用外卦定方向。
note.en: This entry is almost the same passage as the last paragraph of this chapter's 'where the illness was contracted' (LY.ILL.EL.03), except that there the question was from where the illness rose and here it is in which direction the haunting ghost lies. In the case of Yi (the hexagram): the ghost (the Pressure line, Metal) lies hidden under the third line, the flying line of the third line is Gengchen, and Chen belongs to the southeast; the case of Song is the same as in LY.ILL.EL.03 (the ghost hidden under the third line, Wu Fire, the south). It is the same method as the Yi Mao's 'four cases in examining a ghost' (LY.ILL.YM.55), 'where the illness rose from' (LY.ILL.YM.29) and the Yi Yin's 'the direction from which the illness rose' (LY.ILL.YY.33). 'Where there is a ghost among the six lines, look at it so' means that when the hexagram has a ghost and no moving line, the outer trigram fixes the direction.

units.chapter_en: Chapter 74: Searching out ghosts and spirits
units.title: 搜决神鬼章结语：细查何象临官便议何神作祟；请祷则福无不至、祈禳则祸无不消；作此篇为却灾度命，恐人妄断而好杀费财，万不可轻言，须将六兽配五行细论方判无私

rule.yi: 仔细查看是哪个象临在官鬼上，才议论是哪位神在作祟，这样请祷就没有福不到的，祈禳就没有祸不消的。现在作这一篇，恳切是为了却灾、度人性命，又恐怕人乱判断，常常担心人好杀生而白费钱财，万万不可轻易说，一样一样都要细细论，把六兽端正地配上五行来决断诸神，终究没有一个错误，详审它的确实，才判得没有私心。
rule.en: Examine carefully which image sits on the Pressure line, and only then discuss which god is haunting; so prayer brings blessing everywhere and exorcism removes calamity everywhere. This chapter is written earnestly to ward off calamity and save lives, and for fear that people judge at random, always worrying that they are fond of killing and waste money, one must by no means speak lightly; each point must be discussed in detail, matching the six beasts correctly with the five phases to decide the spirits, so that in the end there is not one error, and its certainty is examined carefully, and only then is the judgment without partiality.

zh: 细查何象临官，便议何神作祟，请祷则福无不至，祈禳则祸无不消，今作此篇切为却灾而度命，恐人妄断，恒忧好杀而费财，万不可轻言，一一还须细论，将六兽端配五行决诸神，终无一误详其的确，方判无私。
yi: 仔细查看是哪个象临在官鬼上，才议论是哪位神在作祟，这样请祷就没有福不到的，祈禳就没有祸不消的；现在作这一篇，恳切是为了却灾、度人性命，又恐怕人乱判断，常常担心人好杀生而白费钱财，万万不可轻易说，一样一样都要细细论，把六兽端正地配上五行来决断诸神，终究没有一个错误，详审它的确实，才判得没有私心。
en: Examine carefully which image sits on the Pressure line, and only then discuss which god is haunting; so prayer brings blessing everywhere and exorcism removes calamity everywhere; this chapter is written earnestly to ward off calamity and save lives, and for fear that people judge at random, always worrying that they are fond of killing and waste money, one must by no means speak lightly; each point must be discussed in detail, matching the six beasts correctly with the five phases to decide the spirits, so that in the end there is not one error, and its certainty is examined carefully, and only then is the judgment without partiality.

dispute.yi: 要不要指到某一位神、祭祀要不要杀牲：易林补遗在本章前面列了大量神名，这里的收束是「恐人妄断，恒忧好杀而费财，万不可轻言」，一样一样细论、把六兽配五行才可判，而它随后的「解禳通用法」（LY.ILL.EL.54）更是劝人不要杀牲、多用斋戒念经；易冒也在结尾说「必实指鬼神而泥之则诬矣」，并且「祭祀莫善于解禳，解禳莫善于修身」（LY.ILL.YM.63、YM.64）；增删卜易的李我平批评指定神名（LY.ILL.ZS.25），野鹤反对杀牲救命（LY.ILL.ZS.25）。这几家在收束上意见接近。
dispute.en: Whether to pin it to a particular god, and whether sacrifice should involve slaughter: the Yilin Buyi lists a great many names of gods earlier in the chapter, but its closing here is 'fearing people will judge at random, always worrying that they love killing and waste money, one must by no means speak lightly', so that each point must be discussed in detail and the six beasts matched with the five phases before one may judge, and its following 'general methods of exorcism' (LY.ILL.EL.54) go further and urge people not to slaughter but to use fasting and the recitation of scriptures; the Yi Mao also closes with 'to point insistently at a particular ghost or spirit and cling to it is to make a false claim' and 'of sacrifice none is better than exorcism, and of exorcism none is better than cultivating oneself' (LY.ILL.YM.63, YM.64); Li Woping of the Zengshan Buyi criticises pinning names (LY.ILL.ZS.25), and the Old Man of Yehe opposes slaughter to save a life (LY.ILL.ZS.25). These books are close in their closing views.

note.yi: 这一句的文字有些含混：「今作此篇切为却灾而度命」的「切」是恳切；「恒忧好杀而费财」是担心世人因为鬼神之说而宰杀牲畜、花费家财；「将六兽端配五行决诸神」是说要把六神和五行按次序配起来去断哪位神，不可随意。「终无一误详其的确，方判无私」的「无私」是不偏私、不受情面左右。
note.en: The wording of this sentence is somewhat loose: the 'qie' in 'written earnestly (qie) to ward off calamity and save lives' is earnestness; 'always worrying that they love killing and waste money' is the worry that, because of talk of ghosts and spirits, people will slaughter animals and spend their household wealth; 'matching the six beasts correctly with the five phases to decide the spirits' means matching the six spirits with the five phases in order to decide which god, not at will. 'Without partiality' in 'only then is the judgment without partiality' means impartial and not swayed by favour.
